My VA Support is seeking a Virtual Interior Designer with a high level of English proficiency (B2+) for a full-time position requiring 45 hours per week.
As an Interior Designer, you'll create functional, safe, and aesthetically pleasing spaces by assessing space requirements, determining optimal furniture placement, and selecting decorative items, adhering to relevant blueprint, building code, and inspection requirements.
Daily tasks include assisting with various duties such as modifying SketchUp drawings, creating new drawings with AutoCAD, and occasionally editing photos, changing backgrounds, or modifying images in Photoshop.
Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with clients to understand initial goals and requirements for the space.
  • Work with architects, engineers, painters, and builders for comprehensive space understanding.
  • Analyze movement and use patterns of the space.
  • Prepare sketches or other visual aids to demonstrate preliminary designs to the client.
  • Consult with clients to select materials, furnishings, and décor.
  • Use design applications to prepare and illustrate final plans.
  • Determine project timelines and costs, presenting accurate estimates to clients.
  • Obtain necessary materials, adhering to project and budget specifications.
  • Oversee the installation of materials, furniture, and other design elements.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by resolving any complaints or concerns.
  • Maintain current knowledge of trends, materials, techniques, and other developments in interior design.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, AutoCAD, Reddit, SketchUp, and MS Office Suite.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong sense of style and ability to create aesthetically pleasing interiors.
  • Proficient visual design skills, including proportion and aesthetics.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to use computer-aided design (CAD) software.
  • Basic understanding of building codes and inspection regulations related to interiors.
Education and Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or a related field.
  • Coursework in computer-aided design (CAD) highly preferred.
  • Interior design certification highly preferred.
  • At least one year of related experience required.

Benefits

  • 100% work from home
  • Structured work schedule
  • Payment commensurate with experience and expectations
We look forward to receiving your application!

Position: Interior Architect/Designer (Medical & Commercial Fitouts)

Salary: Open

Working Hours & Conditions: AU business hours

OVERVIEW:

Our client is a premier Australian medical and commercial fitout specialist known for delivering end-to-end design and construction solutions across healthcare, dental, pharmacy, and commercial spaces. As part of their global expansion, they are seeking an experienced Interior Architect / Designer to lead client-facing concept design, space planning, and layout coordination. This critical offshore role serves as the first point of contact for prospective clients—running initial consultations, transforming client briefs into high-impact concept designs, and guiding owners toward commercially sound, highly functional solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Client Consultations & Concept Design: Act as the initial primary point of contact for prospective clients; conduct discovery meetings, understand operational needs, and deliver engaging concept presentations that win trust and convert inquiries.
  • Space Planning & Layout Coordination: Develop high-performance space plans for specialized medical environments (e.g., reception, consultation rooms, dental surgeries, sterilization areas, and amenities) with a strong focus on workflow, circulation, and equipment integration.
  • Finish & Material Selection: Specify durable, aesthetically elevated, and compliant materials, finishes, lighting, and custom joinery tailored to healthcare and commercial applications.
  • Commercial Guidance: Confidently advise clients on layout efficiency, material longevity, and buildability, balancing design aesthetics with commercial viability.
  • Design & Documentation Delivery: Produce high-quality concept packages, detailed layout coordination drawings, joinery details, and finishes schedules for internal teams and project managers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Australian-based project managers, contracts administrators, and external engineering/building consultants to ensure design intent aligns seamlessly with site conditions and construction requirements.

Requirements

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or Interior Architecture with 4 to 6+ years of professional experience specializing in interior design, spatial planning, and commercial/healthcare fit-outs.
  • Client-Facing Soft Skills: Exceptional spoken and written English with a confident, consultative communication style capable of running live discovery sessions and pitching design concepts to business owners and medical professionals.
  • Core Technical Competencies: Strong spatial intelligence, material/finish knowledge, and practical understanding of interior construction detailing and joinery design.
  • Software Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of industry-standard design tools (e.g., ArchiCAD, AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Enscape, or similar 3D rendering platforms).
  • Remote Readiness: A reliable home office setup with high-speed internet, a dedicated working space, and the ability to work aligned with Australian business hours.

Preferred Skills: (Nice-To-Have)

  • Previous work on Australian fitout projects.
  • Medical, dental, healthcare or other commercial interior projects.
  • Familiarity with the Australian NCC/BCA, Australian Standards and accessibility requirements relevant to fitout documentation.
  • Experience working remotely with builders, project managers and consultant teams.
  • Experience developing reception designs, detailed joinery packages and coordinated finishes schedules.

Job Description: Fashion and Interior Styling Expert

Role Type: Contractor

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Fashion and Interior Styling Experts to evaluate styling concepts, outfits, room setups, and creative briefs. This role is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in fashion styling, wardrobe styling, interior design, set styling, or home styling.

You will review styling work, assess fit, proportion, color, materials, and overall suitability, and provide clear written explanations for your decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Evaluate outfits and interior setups to determine which best meets a specific brief, season, client, or project requirement.
  2. Assess fit, proportion, scale, color coordination, and material selection.
  3. Identify practical issues, including incorrect sizing, unsuitable fabrics, or items that do not fit the intended space.
  4. Evaluate whether styling concepts align with the project brief, budget, and setting.
  5. Provide concise written explanations supporting styling decisions and recommendations.
  6. Create or improve styling briefs, mood descriptions, and shopping lists.

Required Qualifications

  1. Professional experience as a Fashion Stylist, Wardrobe Stylist, Personal Stylist, Interior Stylist, Set Stylist, Prop Stylist, or Home Stylist.
  2. Hands-on experience managing real-world projects, including brief development, sourcing, fittings, installations, and client delivery.
  3. Strong understanding of styling principles, including fit, proportion, color coordination, materials, and spatial suitability.
  4. Ability to evaluate styling concepts and clearly explain why one look or space works better than another.
  5. Strong written English communication skills.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Submit your resume and a short professional profile.
  2. Styling Interview: Complete a brief conversation about your experience with fashion and interior styling, sourcing, and project execution. No preparation or written assignment is required.
  3. Experience Review: Your qualifications will be assessed against the project requirements.
  4. Onboarding and Initial Task: Selected candidates will receive project guidelines and complete an initial task for review before proceeding.
